# MUFU.<OP> of an RTX 3060 (sm_86, driver 610.88, 2026-11-15), from tools/numerics/mufu_probe --vectors 150. "= <OP>" starts an
# operation; then "<operand bits> <result bits>" a line: 160 edge operands (80 and their negatives), then 150 drawn from a
# fixed generator (three in four with the exponent within 24 of 1). The operand is a float's bits; for RCP64H and RSQ64H the
# upper word of a double. tests/unit/test_mufu_model.cpp holds the simulator's model to every line.
